period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary quarterly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements for the 1st Quarter Ended 31 March 2011 (Unaudited)"). This copy is a scanned image (Canon-scanner-produced, no usable text layer) rather than a native-text PDF; figures were read visually from a high-resolution page render. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 31 March 2011' / 'Profit and Loss Account for the first quarter ended 31 March 2011') figures are used, not 'Consolidated'. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 84,183.01m + Total equity 11,776.72m = Total assets 95,959.73m exactly; every P&L subtotal from Total operating income (1,552.28m) down to Net profit after tax (266.28m) reconciles exactly; EPS of 6.85 reconciles with Net profit after tax / 38,885,472 shares (paid-up capital of BDT 3,888,547,200 at a BDT100 face value per share, pre-dating the bank's later stock split to BDT10 face value). Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). NAV per share is not disclosed in this primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap. This is the earliest primary interim statement recovered for City Bank in this dataset.
